sampling.geometry_metric: max over dense centreline samples of the exact point-to-curve distance, bidirectional
sampling.transition_arclength: flat parts consume their 2D length; transitions consume their XY footprint

notes: Independent validator: own rotation/geometry formulas; the orbit definition comes from connectivity_1024.json, the verdict never uses eight_builder-side symmetry metadata.
Error counts are pair counts over (orbit, k); the *_orbits fields count distinct orbits and are the headline numbers.

A member may be traversed in the opposite direction; layer and transition sequences are then compared reversed and transition z0/z1 swapped, and the representative is sampled from both traversal ends for the geometry check.
